record.original_question: Does there exist, in ZFC, an uncountable set of reals satisfying S_1(B_Γ, B), meaning that for every sequence of countable Borel γ-covers one can choose one set from each cover so that the chosen sets form a countable Borel cover?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.2 ([33], [47, Problem 45], [6]). Does there exist (in ZFC) an uncountable set of reals satisfying S1(BΓ, B)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. For a topological space $X$ (in particular, a set of real numbers with the subspace topology), an open cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is called a $\gamma$-cover if $\mathcal{U}$ is infinite and every $x \in X$ belongs to all but finitely many members of $\mathcal{U}$. A cover whose members are Borel subsets of $X$ is called a Borel cover, and a Borel $\gamma$-cover is a $\gamma$-cover consisting of Borel sets. Denote by $\mathcal{B}_\Gamma$ the family of all countable Borel $\gamma$-covers of $X$, and by $\mathcal{B}$ the family of all countable Borel covers of $X$.

For families $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{B}$ of covers, the selection principle $\mathsf{S}_1(\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B})$ asserts: for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ with each $\mathcal{U}_n \in \mathcal{A}$, there exist $U_n \in \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\{U_n : n \in \mathbb{N}\} \in \mathcal{B}$.

Question: Does there exist (provably in ZFC) an uncountable set $X \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ satisfying $\mathsf{S}_1(\mathcal{B}_\Gamma, \mathcal{B})$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a well-known problem in the theory of selection principles (appearing as Problem 45 on Tsaban's list of open problems). Surveys and follow-up papers describe it as one of the major open problems of the area, equivalent to asking whether ZFC proves the existence of an uncountable set of reals that can be Borel-mapped onto a dominating subset of $\mathbb{N}^\mathbb{N}$. No ZFC construction or refutation appears to have been published.

status_evidence.snippet: Problem 45: Does there exist (in ZFC) an uncountable set of reals satisfying S_1(B_Gamma, B)?

status_evidence.title: The γ-Borel conjecture (A. W. Miller)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Borel γ-covers and selection principles, noting open problems about uncountable sets in ZFC.
status_evidence.claim: Related ZFC-existence questions for uncountable sets with Borel γ-cover selection properties remain unresolved.
